senses.gloss: (b. h.) to bend, bow (interch. with שָׁחָה a. שׁוּחַ).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:4:4">Y. Ber. I, 3ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>אלו … ששׁוֹחֲחִין וכ׳</he> these are the benedictions at which you must bow &c.; <he>השׁוֹחֵחַ … שלא יָשׁוֹחַ</he> (or <he>יָשׁוּחַ</he>) if one bows at every benediction, we teach him that he must not do so; <cite ref="Berakhot 34a">Ber. 34ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 39">Gen. R. s. 39</cite> <he>והשׁוֹחֶה … לָשׁוֹחַ</he> (or <he>לָשׁוּחַ</he>); <cite ref="Tosefta Berakhot 1:9">Tosef. Ber. I, 9</cite> <he>השׁוֹחֶה … שלא יִשְׁחֶה</he>.

<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 4:6">Ruth R. to II, 5</cite> <he>כל הנשים שׁוֹחֲחוֹת וכ׳</he> all other women stooped in gleaning, but she (Ruth) sat down; (Yalk. ib. 601 <cite ref="P00279"><he>עומדות</he></cite>).
